name: Cannalicious Live Resin | Blueberry Blast
description: Blueberry Blast is a sativa-dominant hybrid created by crossing Blue Dream and Johnny Blaze. Bursting with sweet blueberry flavor and subtle floral notes, it delivers an uplifting, energetic high with a clear-headed focus. Perfect for daytime use, this strain is favored for boosting mood, sparking creativity, and providing a smooth, flavorful experience.
